nuggets.text: Mike McCarthy grew up in Pittsburgh's Greenfield neighborhood, the son of a city firefighter and police officer.
Mike McCarthy is only the fourth head coach the Steelers have hired since 1969.
Mike McCarthy beat the Steelers 31-25 in Super Bowl XLV with Green Bay, and now he is their head coach.
Aaron Rodgers, 42, says his 22nd NFL season will be his last: 'This is it.'
Aaron Rodgers played 13 years under Mike McCarthy in Green Bay before the two reunited in Pittsburgh.
The Steelers are the only NFL team with their logo on just one side of the helmet, the right side.
Broadcaster Myron Cope invented the Terrible Towel in 1975, and it has raised over $6 million for the Allegheny Valley School.
A Terrible Towel has been waved aboard the International Space Station and carried to the top of Mount Everest.
In 1943 the Steelers merged with the Eagles for one season, and the combined team was known as the 'Steagles.'
T.J. Watt and his brother J.J. Watt were the first brothers to appear together on a Wheaties box, in 2023.
